verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers a Batch Transfers API explicitly designed for bulk operations across many transfers/beneficiaries at once (payroll runs, supplier payments), plus a CLI and AgentOS toolkit enabling AI agents to programmatically drive these operations. This directly supports an AI-native user performing bulk operations, though it's mainly limited to payments/transfers rather than bulk operations across all entity types (cards, accounts, etc.). missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints for other resources (cards, accounts payable, connected accounts), independent hands-on confirmation of batch transfer reliability at scale.
